title: scripts/pin-joomla-cowork.mjs moves the Joomla quickstarts' Claude Cowork pins onto a published release — five values per older pin, the same text in both quickstarts.json copies, nothing else — and refuses, writing nothing, when the release does not carry the profiles a pin records byte for byte or the download is not what GitHub states
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/test/pin-joomla-cowork.test.mjs (fixture releases built in the test: --release <json> --zip <bytes> --root <tmp tree>; no network).
S2: Record the exit code, '# fail', and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: A release carrying the recorded profiles moves every older Joomla pin: only file, version, bytes, sha256 and url change (ten lines for two pins), both catalogues stay one text, a newer pin and a WordPress pin are untouched, inline arrays and notes keep their bytes.
--dry-run prints a git-style diff for both catalogues and writes nothing.

A pin already on the release is verified and left alone (empty diff, 'nothing to move'); the same tag with other bytes is refused as a re-cut; --quickstart moves only the named pin and refuses a non-Joomla one.
A release missing a recorded profile, a recorded file, or carrying a changed or unrecorded file in a recorded profile is refused with that file named, exit 1, nothing written.
A size or digest that disagrees with GitHub, a package declaring another version, a draft, a pre-release, an asset served elsewhere or not uploaded is refused; a release-candidate tag exits 2.
Two catalogues that already differ, and a pin fetched by githubAssetId, are refused.
On the committed catalogues and this tree's own profile files, every Joomla pin moves with five lines each and nothing else changes.
evidence: The same move made by hand: 7ccf04fd5 (#1013, 0.24.5), 10633e467 (#1091, 0.24.7), 8644e8e2b (#1098, 0.24.8). Replaying #1013 on its parent with --tag joomla-v0.24.5 writes both files byte for byte as that commit, but for one sentence of prose in a note.
fence: Only file/version/bytes/sha256/url of a Joomla cowork pin are rewritten, in both catalogues at once, and only after the release's zip is read and found to carry every recorded profile byte for byte.

tests: a release carrying the recorded profiles moves every older Joomla pin
--dry-run prints the diff and writes nothing
a pin already on the release is verified and left alone
a release that does not carry a recorded profile byte for byte is refused
a download or a release that is not what it claims is refused
two catalogues that already differ, or a pin fetched by githubAssetId, are refused
